mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ESIM_INSTALL_TOKEN ( token, order_id, payload_json, expire_dt, regist_dt ) VALUES ( #{token}, #{orderId}, #{payloadJson}, #{expireDt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, token, order_id AS orderId, payload_json AS payloadJson, expire_dt AS expireDt, regist_dt AS registDt FROM TB_ESIM_INSTALL_TOKEN WHERE token = #{token} AND expire_dt > NOW() LIMIT 1
